newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to privatise seven industrial plants.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to privatise seven industrial plants.

text.p: Turkey's Privatisation Administration (OIB) said on Saturday it would sell its stakes in two cement plants, three factories and two foundaries with bids due by December 2.

It said its 100 percent holdings in Ergani, two Kurtalan cement plants, Konya and Filyos plants, Bozuyuk ceramics unit, and 49.6 percent stake in Cemas and 30.41 percent in Cimhol foundaries would be privatised through block sales.
The tenders will be held through negotiations and bids will be submitted in dollar terms, it said.
All the plants but Cemas and Cimhol were put up for sale last year but their tenders were cancelled after the OIB said bids were not satisfactory.
